remarks: Discover elevated living in this turnkey 2 bedroom 2 bathroom condo perfectly situated in a private building in downtown Stamford. Offering 1,407 square feet of open concept living space, this condo combines comfort, convenience and style with thoughtful updates throughout. Step into a sun-filled oversized living and dining area, with a large slider leading out to a spacious private balcony overlooking the city, the perfect spot to enjoy morning sunrises quietly located in the back of the building, off the street. Back inside, the kitchen features a breakfast bar designed for both entertaining and everyday living. Luxurious primary bedroom features an en-suite bathroom and a walk in closet. Second bedroom is oversized w/ ample closet space. A second full bathroom serves the second bedroom and guests with ease. Features include a newer HVAC system, a newer hot water heater, all new flooring & in-unit full size laundry. Residents of this well maintained elevator building enjoy outstanding amenities including a state of the art fitness center w/ sauna and two parking spaces with one reserved garage spot and an additional covered space on a first come first serve basis. Located just steps from downtown Stamford, Mill River Park, Scalzi Park, shopping, dining, entertainment & the train station, this home delivers the perfect combination of luxury and convenience.
